notes:
Default v3.1.409 reports the measured envelope peak and adds a two-minute
standalone protocol-selection timeout. The timeout restarts after meaningful
knob movement, including movement within one preset zone. START at the deadline
takes priority. Runs, GUI-owned operation, calibration, completion and fault
screens do not use this inactivity timeout.

OLED and GUI results now show the detected peak. PVR continues at peak+5 mmHg,
capped at130 for Smart Const and140 for High Max. Rejected peaks still use the
labeled80-mmHg fallback. Raw events retain peak and actual hold separately.

Firmware:rev27v-followup-356; OLED release date11/19/2026.
Calibration, estimator, SNR, PID, valve limits and pressure limits are unchanged.

Validation:166 focused checks, then31 reporting/banner/help checks (overlapping
sets); seven standard suites plus protocol parity. Arduino Due compilation
passed. Hardware was unavailable: protected flashing and a ten-minute scored
soak remain outstanding. This release does not claim bench qualification or
resolution of the previously recorded control-performance weaknesses.
